verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a contract-management SaaS with AI features (ironclad-docs-12, ironclad-docs-24), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use controls for AI models. The 'Store Contracts Securely' page title is an adjacent claim about storage security and does not address AI training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
